text: dsh-web-notification 是面向 DSH Web 的通知插件，在浏览器端监听已打开会话的完成轮次，并在模型回复结束后弹出系统级 Web Notification。它从会话快照取得本轮用户消息作为通知正文；消息不可用时回退到会话标题。插件自动请求通知权限，并在首次用户手势时重试；通知按会话和轮次区分，避免重复提示。适合希望切换到其他窗口时仍能知道 DSH 回复已完成的 Web 用户。需要浏览器支持并允许 Notification 权限。

dsh-web-notification alerts DSH Web users when a reply finishes. It watches open sessions and displays the user message or session title. It requests browser notification permission and tracks turns to avoid duplicate alerts.
DSH 网页里模型回复完了能提醒我吗？
切到别的窗口后，我想知道聊天什么时候结束。
让 DSH Web 在每轮回答完成时弹出桌面通知。
有没有办法不用一直盯着网页等模型回复？
Show me a browser notification after the assistant finishes answering.
Can I get an alert instead of watching the chat page?
dsh-web-notification 的功能「回复完成通知：监听已打开会话的完成轮次，并弹出系统通知，正文显示该轮用户消息；没有可用消息时显示会话标题。」
dsh-web-notification 的功能「通知权限请求：插件启动时请求浏览器通知权限，并在首次鼠标或键盘手势时重试；卸载时移除监听器。」
dsh-web-notification 的功能「多会话监听：同步会话列表，为新增会话建立订阅，并在会话移除或插件卸载时清理订阅。」
我离开聊天页面时，也想收到回答完成的提示。
有没有网页通知能告诉我模型这一轮已经答完？

dsh-web-notification README · dsh-web-notification：English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Show a system-level Web Notification when the model finishes a reply in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — whether or not the page is focused.

dsh-web-notification README · Features：- Fires a system notification on every completed reply: title `🐳 Model Replied`, body = the user message of this turn
  - Falls back to the session title when no user message is available
- Requests notification permission automatically at boot and on the first user gesture (Safari requires a gesture)
- Deduplicates per turn, so a reply never notifies twice
- No UI injection: mounts no visible elements

dsh-web-notification README · How It Works：- **Detection**: the client watches every open session's snapshot `turnEnds` (`Map<turn, endSeq>`); a turn count increase means one reply completed — multi-session replies each fire their own notification. The triggering user message text is read from the `chat` nodes.
- **Display**: every notification uses a unique tag (`dsh-reply-done-<sessionId>-<turn>`) with `renotify: true`. Same-tag notifications have *replace* semantics — while the previous one is still visible, the replacement does not re-show a banner on macOS/Chrome.
- **Packaging**: `build.mjs` wraps `src/client/index.js` in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` handshake, which the browser module table executes.

dsh-web-notification README · Installation (Users)：Prerequisites: `dsh` installed (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`) and the web profile initialized.

```sh
dsh-web-notification README · 1. Install the bundle：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/2h0n/dsh-web-notification/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz

dsh-web-notification README · 2. Restart：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

Verify: no `dsh-web-notification` errors in the browser console; send two messages in the same session and confirm each reply fires a notification; restart once more and confirm the plugin is still there.

dsh-web-notification README · 2. Restart：> - `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory, and because the package declares `dsh.bundle`, it automatically appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles`. If you install with a bare `pnpm add` instead, add the bundles entry manually.
> - If installation fails with `ERR_PNPM_TARBALL_INTEGRITY` (stale lockfile checksums from other moving-branch dependencies in the profile), run `pnpm install --update-checksums` first and retry.
dsh-web-notification README · Requirements：- Node.js 22.19+ or 24+ (matching the DeepSeek Harness supported range; the build is dependency-free — no npm packages to install)

dsh-web-notification README · Directory Structure：```
dsh-web-notification/
├── package.json          # Manifest: exports + dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # Patch entry (plugin rows), referenced by dsh.bundle.patch
├── dsh.plugin.json       # Plugin manifest

dsh-web-notification README · Local Development：The official way: install the local checkout into the profile (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin add` links the directory and registers the bundle automatically):

```sh
dsh-web-notification README · 1. Build：node build.mjs
dsh-web-notification README · 2. Install the local checkout：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"

dsh-web-notification README · 3. Restart：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If pnpm is not available, link it manually (equivalent result):

```sh
ln -s "$PWD" ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-web-notification

dsh-web-notification README · dsh.profile.bundles: append "dsh-web-notification"：```

Iteration loop after editing code (symlinked, no reinstall needed):

```sh
node build.mjs            # regenerate lib/
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web  # restart (file: symlink — no reinstall needed)
```

dsh-web-notification README · Removing：The official way (removes the dependency and its bundle layer together):

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-notification
```

For a manually linked install, undo the steps:

```sh
rm ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-web-notification

dsh-web-notification README · remove "dsh-web-notification" from dependencies and dsh.profile.bundles：```

Restart `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` afterwards.
